title: Digital India BHASHINI Division & NITI Aayog Partner for 'BHASHINI for Seva' Initiative
summary: DIBD and NITI Aayog partnered for voice-first AI solutions supporting 36 Indian text and 23 Indian voice languages.

blocks.content: DIBD and NITI Aayog partnered for voice-first AI solutions supporting 36 Indian text and 23 Indian voice languages.

items: **Initiative:** 'BHASHINI for Seva / Sanchalan' for multilingual citizen-centric service delivery.
